DT_Data.py

Abstract base class for all data sources in the Digital Twin system. Implements ObserverDataManager to support the Observer Pattern.

It maintains a list of observers (Models and Services) and notifies them automatically when data is updated via update_data().

class Data.DT_Data.DT_Data[source]¶

Bases: ObserverDataManager, ABC

Abstract base class representing a source of data (the “Physical Twin” side of the Digital Twin).

get_data_name()[source]¶

Returns the name of this data source.

notify_observers()[source]¶

Notifies every registered observer that data has changed.

register_observer(observer)[source]¶

Registers an observer if it is not already registered.

remove_observer(observer)[source]¶

Removes a previously registered observer.

update_data()[source]¶

Updates the data and notifies all registered observers (Models and Services). This is the central method that triggers the Observer Pattern.

Data.DT_Data_SineValues module¶

DT_Data_SineValues.py

Concrete data class that generates and stores sine wave values. Every time 10 new values are added, it triggers notification to all observers using the Observer Pattern.

This represents the “Physical Twin” part of the Digital Twin.

This is the Python equivalent of Data/DT_Data_SineValues.java.

@author Zeeshan ALI, Mamadou Kaba TRAORE @version 1.0 (Python port)

class Data.DT_Data_SineValues.DT_Data_SineValues(name: str)[source]¶

Bases: DT_Data

get_current_index() → int[source]¶

Returns the current index (number of values pushed so far). Used by the chart and diagnosis service to plot the correct x-axis.

get_sine_data_values()[source]¶

Returns the list of all sine values collected so far.

push_back(val: float)[source]¶

Adds a new sine value to the collection. Increments the index and triggers notification to observers every 10 values.

Parameters:

val – The sine value to add.
